fact: Themberchaud is flying the party over Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The party climbs onto the voluminous back of the dragon as he takes flight within the massive cavern.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gracklstugh sits in a huge cavern, surrounded by small tunnels that prevent Themberchaud from leaving.
source_quote: The DM explains the city sits in a huge cavern, but beyond it are only small tunnels, so Themberchaud cannot really leave.
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 13 on a Persuasion check to convince Themberchaud to drop the party at the docks.
source_quote: Gyrgum rolls a 13 on Persuasion, and a helped reroll comes out worse.
subject: persuasion attempt

fact: Themberchaud admits he does not know where to investigate.
source_quote: Asked where to investigate, Themberchaud reveals he has no clue.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud concedes that the docks might be a district his agents missed.
source_quote: Themberchaud asks, "Are you suggesting that I've missed a crucial district…?" He concedes, "Hmm, that's a good point."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Themberchaud makes an inelegant turn to bank toward the docks.
source_quote: As the dragon makes an inelegant turn, the party makes DC 13 Athletics or Acrobatics checks.
subject: dragon turn

fact: Gyrgum rolls a 12 on an Athletics or Acrobatics check during the dragon's turn.
source_quote: Gyrgum gets 12.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Thorin fails his Athletics or Acrobatics check, rolling a natural 3 plus 4.
source_quote: Thorin rolls a natural 3 +4, then uses a 1d10 boost and still fails.
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz rolls an 8 on an Athletics or Acrobatics check during the dragon's turn.
source_quote: Daz gets 8.
subject: Daz

fact: Several party members lose their footing and begin to fall off Themberchaud's back.
source_quote: Several party members lose their footing and begin to fall.
subject: falling party members

fact: Zalthir sprouts wings.
source_quote: Zalthir sprouts wings and catches the falling Thorin.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir catches the falling Thorin while flying.
source_quote: Zalthir sprouts wings and catches the falling Thorin.
subject: Zalthir catch

fact: Zalthir is level five.
source_quote: Zalthir, newly level five, sprouted wings and caught the falling Thorin
subject: Zalthir

fact: Daz casts Misty Step and teleports in a silvery mist to a spot next to Zalthir.
source_quote: Daz casts Misty Step and teleports in a silvery mist to a spot right next to the flying Zalthir.
subject: Daz teleport

fact: Gyrgum cries out to Bahamut while falling.
source_quote: As Gyrgum falls, he cries out to Bahamut.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Jimjar throws a rope to the falling Gyrgum.
source_quote: Jimjar saves the falling Gyrgum by tossing a rope to him mid-air.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Gyrgum catches the rope with a 19 on Acrobatics.
source_quote: Gyrgum catches it with a 19 on Acrobatics.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party hauls Gyrgum back up onto the dragon's back.
source_quote: The whole party hauls him back up.
subject: party rescue

fact: Themberchaud flaps harder in distress after seeing the party fall.
source_quote: Themberchaud, distraught, flaps harder. "If dragons could sweat, there would be lots of sweat."
subject: Themberchaud

fact: The air above Gracklstugh is foul with forge smoke.
source_quote: The air is foul with forge smoke.
subject: Gracklstugh air

fact: The party ties themselves together with rope.
source_quote: The party ties themselves together with rope.
subject: rope

fact: Themberchaud performs a fly-by of the Forge of Thrazgad.
source_quote: Themberchaud performs a fly-by of the Forge of Thrazgad
subject: Forge of Thrazgad

fact: Themberchaud breathes fire to light the Forge of Thrazgad.
source_quote: Themberchaud performs a fly-by of the Forge of Thrazgad, breathing fire to light it while boasting of his own greatness.
subject: forge lighting

fact: The duergar roll their eyes at Themberchaud's ego.
source_quote: sees the duergar rolling their eyes at his ego.
subject: duergar

fact: The citizens of Gracklstugh see the party riding the dragon.
source_quote: Citizens of Gracklstugh witness the party riding the dragon
subject: citizen witness

fact: The citizens mistake the party for the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: mistake them for the legendary and powerful Ember Vanguard, which Daz confirms with a natural 20.
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: Daz rolls a natural 20 on Insight.
source_quote: which Daz confirms with a natural 20.
subject: Daz

fact: The city of Gracklstugh is thrown into hysterics.
source_quote: The city is thrown into hysterics.
subject: city panic

fact: In rumor, Daz is an 18th-level mage able to cast Meteor Swarm.
source_quote: with Daz rumored as an 18th-level mage.
subject: Daz rumor

fact: Themberchaud lands heavily at the docks of the Darklake.
source_quote: Themberchaud lands heavily at the docks.
subject: docks of the Darklake

fact: Themberchaud uses his frightful presence to frighten the local populace.
source_quote: He roars and uses his frightful presence to frighten the local populace.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gyrgum promises to search the docks.
source_quote: Gyrgum answers, "Aye aye, we will search the docks far and wide,"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Themberchaud departs for his lair.
source_quote: before the dragon departs for his lair.
subject: dragon departure
